low_power_modes_summary.bus_idle: When no MASTER is active, [CYC_O]=0 and [STB_O]=0 on all interfaces. Bus is idle. Clock gating of [CLK_I] is integrator-defined.
low_power_modes_summary.gated_clock_option: Section 2.1.1 RULE 2.15 item 12 — the WISHBONE DATASHEET MUST indicate any constraints on the [CLK_I] signal, including clock frequency, application-specific timing constraints, the use of gated clocks or the use of variable clock generators. OBSERVATION 3.15 — if a gated clock generator is used, and if the clock is stopped, then the WISHBONE interface is not capable of responding to its [RST_I] signal.
low_power_modes_summary.variable_clock_option: Section 1.2 Objectives — to create a variable timing mechanism whereby the system clock frequency can be adjusted so as to control the power consumption of the integrated circuit.
low_power_modes_summary.off_chip_low_speed: Section 1.2 Objectives — to create a synchronous protocol that is optimized for System-on-Chip, but that is also suitable for off-chip I/O routing. Generally, the off-chip WISHBONE interconnect will operate at slower speeds (typically driving lower-power off-chip drivers).

fields.notes: Power-domain partitioning, voltage-domain crossings, power-gate sequencing, isolation cells, retention registers are all OUTSIDE the Wishbone protocol layer. They are deferred to the SoC integration spec (UPF / CPF). Wishbone B4 only acknowledges that the bus designer MAY use clock gating or variable clock frequency to control power consumption — those mechanisms must be declared in the IP's WISHBONE DATASHEET.

evidence.quote: To create a variable timing mechanism whereby the system clock frequency can be adjusted so as to control the power consumption of the integrated circuit.

The WISHBONE DATASHEET MUST indicate if there are any constraints on the [CLK_I] signal. These constraints include (but are not limited to) clock frequency, application specific timing constraints, the use of gated clocks or the use of variable clock generators.
If a gated clock generator is used, and if the clock is stopped, then the WISHBONE interface is not capable of responding to its [RST_I] signal.
